name: Spell Envelope
body:
School abjuration; Level arcanist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, cleric/oracle/warpriest 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (powdered iron), DF Range special

EFFECT

Target one creature
Duration 1 round (see text)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance special

DESCRIPTION

You weave an anti-magical cocoon to more easily pierce a single creature’s spell resistance. Until the end of your next round, one spell may be placed in the cocoon and hurled towards the designated target. The spell placed inside the cocoon does not have to be yours, but if cast by another, that caster must be within 10 feet of you. The spell resistance of the target creature is reduced by 5 for this one spell. This spell stacks with feats that reduce spell resistance. If the spell contained in the envelope does not target or affect the target of spell envelope, the magic fizzles and fades.

Spell Envelope, Greater

School abjuration; Level arcanist 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, cleric/oracle/warpriest 5

DESCRIPTION

Note: This spell was designed to be used by dragons, thus it may alter or replace core dragon abilities (like frightful presence etc.)

As spell envelope, but the spell resistance of the target creature is reduced by 15 for the one spell stored in the spell envelope.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
